summary: HF snapshot_download of the 102GB metadata_texts.npy hard-stalled mid-transfer on EC2 (zero EBS writes 20+ min, CPU 6%, ~1-13KB/5min network). Small files downloaded fine; the huge texts file hangs — same signature as the HF Space's 'Fetching 26 files' stall.
root_cause: huggingface_hub snapshot_download stalls on very large files; the connection dies mid-transfer and does not resume within a reasonable window. The default downloader lacks aggressive stall detection. Fixed by decoupling download into its own phase with hf_transfer (Rust, retries+resume) and a stall-kill-resume watchdog.
